clause_summary: Maintain a documented policy governing how AI systems are developed and used.
Identify other organizational policies that bear on AI and reconcile them.
Review the AI policy at planned intervals and when circumstances change.
Define and assign AI-related roles and responsibilities across the organization.
Provide a process for raising concerns about an AI system across its life cycle.
Identify and document the resources needed at each AI life-cycle stage.
Document the data resources used by the AI system.
Document the tooling used to develop and run the AI system.
Document the system and computing resources supporting the AI system.
Document the human resources and competencies across the AI life cycle.
Establish a process to assess AI system consequences for individuals, groups, and society.

short_label: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
clause_summary: Document impact-assessment results and retain them for a defined period.

short_label: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups
clause_summary: Assess and document potential effects on individuals and groups of individuals.

short_label: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
clause_summary: Assess and document potential societal impacts across the life cycle.
Set and document objectives that guide responsible AI development.

short_label: Processes for responsible design and development
clause_summary: Define and document processes for responsible design and development.
Specify and document requirements for new or materially changed AI systems.

short_label: Documentation of AI system design and development
clause_summary: Document AI system design and development against requirements and criteria.
Define, document, and apply verification and validation measures with acceptance criteria.
Document a deployment plan and confirm requirements are met before go-live.
Define ongoing operation and monitoring, including performance tracking and support.
Determine and provide the technical documentation each interested party needs.

short_label: AI system recording of event logs
clause_summary: Enable event logging over the life cycle, at least while the system is in use.

short_label: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
clause_summary: Define, document, and apply data-management processes for AI development.
Determine and document how data is acquired and selected.

short_label: Quality of data for AI systems
clause_summary: Define data-quality requirements and ensure data meets them.
Define and document a process to record the provenance of data used.
Define and document criteria and methods for preparing data.

clause_summary: Determine and provide the information users need about the AI system.
Enable interested parties to report adverse effects of the AI system.
Define and document a plan to communicate incidents to users.
Determine and document obligations to inform interested parties.

short_label: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
clause_summary: Define and document processes for responsible use of AI systems.

short_label: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
clause_summary: Set and document objectives guiding responsible use, including human oversight and fairness.
